newsitem.title: DUBAI: Islamic group to work for peace in Afghanistan.
newsitem.headline: Islamic group to work for peace in Afghanistan.

text.p: The Organisation of Islamic Conference (OIC) said on Monday that it would work for peace and stability in Afghanistan, where the Taleban Islamist militia seized power last week and set up an interim ruling council.

OIC Secretary General Hamid al-Ghabid said in a statement that "the OIC, which has consistently endeavoured to promote a peaceful political settlement in Afghanistan, remains committed to working with the Afghan parties in bringing peace to their country."
The Jeddah-based OIC was formed in 1969 and has 52 members.
